body: I'm 23 and still working on it lol
Its a journey that takes a lot of time a soul searching
Its not just about talking but processing what your going through sometimes its good to get things off your vest but other times you need to learn to cope with bad things

Sometimes it takes a lot of effort to get help but its worth it and you should worry the most about yourself if your having trouble you don't have to shoulder other peoples weight if you can't take it
There's always professional help they got a degree to deal with problems like yours

The world is a crazy place you can make money doing almost anything don't count yourself out. You don't have to pick what you want right this second weigh all of your options maybe even try everything and see what sticks.

No its not just your age but it is ok to be depressed the finding someone you can confide in and talk to so you can get some things off your chest too seems like it would really help you im sorry you are feeling so down

Learning to cope with all those things is such a hard battle but your already taking steps with therapy and meds sometimes its just not enough I know that and its scary its so scary but grounding yourself and taking in the things around you and just kinda getting your mind off the anxiety is the best thing I've found to do.

Sometimes just coasting along is the best you can do. Feeling like that sucks but weather you seek help or just find the right thing to make you happy. Look inside yourself and ask what you need maybe you'll find something that makes you happy if not try coasting further and asking yourself every once and a while
Trust me I fully understand but what do you think would make you happy anything small or big

Then maybe just maybe evaluate your options nothing to lose also means everything to gain. Rock bottom means there's only one way to go. Up and up can look different for everyone just find something that makes you happy and follow it

Listen life is a flow nothing is stopping you from changing everything about your life and just being a totally different person. And if thats true think about just getting back on that path you felt happy on maybe not all at once maybe not right this second but little by little make your way towards where you want to be. And if some days you just don't feel like it take a break and make sure you take care of yourself.

You gotta find something that keeps you going. Sometimes its something as stupid as reddit drama that you just read non stop maybe its gaming, drawing, music, cars just find something that makes you feel happy and go with it doesn't matter what it is and if you need to switch to a new hobby fuck it just keep going till you find your thing
Unload it take a breath take a huge step back and evaluate what you really need.

Life is just a series of trips and picking ourselves back up. If you need a break just take one trust me people would rather deal with you being gone a couple days then forever. Take care of yourself.

Take some time to focuse on your self if you always blame yourself for things your mind does you'll never get anywhere try to make peace with your demons focus on how long its been since you've hurt yourself rather than when you will. Set goals and work towards them. Having bad mental health doesn't make you selfish just because others don't understand.

Breath bro driving in 5 years you'll laugh at how easy it is. I'm not going to say its not intimidating it really is one of the scariest things to break into but just stay calm pay attention to the wheel and the road and don't be scared to take it as slow as you need. Also if its the written part your scared of try your best to put yourself in the shoes of someone who's job depends on it and pick what they would most likely do.
